column.name: name
column.value: Settle on Mat

column.name: description
column.value: Teach the dog to relax on a designated mat on cue.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Lure the dog onto the mat with a treat. Mark and reward calm behavior. Gradually increase duration before rewarding.

column.name: name
column.value: Polite Greetings

column.name: description
column.value: Greet people without jumping.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Ask a helper to approach. Reward four paws on the floor. Have the helper step back if the dog jumps, and only reward calm greetings.

column.name: name
column.value: Wait at Doors

column.name: description
column.value: Wait for permission before going through doorways.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Open the door slightly. If the dog moves toward it, close it. Reward waiting, then release with a cue to pass through.

column.name: name
column.value: Loose Leash Walking

column.name: description
column.value: Walk beside the handler without pulling.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Stop moving the instant the leash goes tight. Resume walking once the dog returns to your side, rewarding frequently.

column.name: name
column.value: Walking Past Distractions

column.name: description
column.value: Maintain loose leash walking near distractions.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Start at a distance from the distraction where the dog can stay focused. Reward attention, gradually decreasing distance over sessions.

column.name: name
column.value: Auto Check-In

column.name: description
column.value: Dog voluntarily looks at the handler while walking.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Walk normally and mark/reward any spontaneous eye contact without cueing it. Increase the interval between rewards over time.

column.name: name
column.value: Basic Recall

column.name: description
column.value: Recall in a low-distraction environment.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Say the recall cue once from a short distance. Reward enthusiastically the instant the dog arrives.

column.name: name
column.value: Long Distance Recall

column.name: description
column.value: Recall from further away.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Gradually increase distance between reps. Use a long line for safety and reward big for full recalls.

column.name: name
column.value: Recall With Distractions

column.name: description
column.value: Recall with competing distractions present.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Introduce mild distractions (toys, other people) at a manageable distance. Reward heavily for choosing to come away from the distraction.

column.name: name
column.value: Heel Position Basics

column.name: description
column.value: Hold the heel position while standing and moving a few steps.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Lure the dog into position at your side. Take one or two steps, mark, and reward while the dog holds position.

column.name: name
column.value: Heel With Turns

column.name: description
column.value: Maintain heel position through turns.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Practice slow turns in both directions, rewarding the dog for adjusting its pace and position to stay aligned.

column.name: name
column.value: Heel Off Leash

column.name: description
column.value: Maintain heel position without a leash.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Remove the leash in a secure area. Reward frequently at first, gradually extending distance between rewards.

column.name: name
column.value: Sit Stay

column.name: description
column.value: Hold a sit position for increasing durations.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Cue a sit, then wait a few seconds before rewarding. Gradually increase the duration before releasing.

column.name: name
column.value: Down Stay

column.name: description
column.value: Hold a down position for increasing durations.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Cue a down, then wait before rewarding. Gradually add duration, distance, and mild distractions.

column.name: name
column.value: Stay With Distance

column.name: description
column.value: Hold a stay while the handler moves away.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Cue a stay, take one step back, then return and reward. Gradually increase the distance you move away.

column.name: name
column.value: Basic Retrieve

column.name: description
column.value: Pick up and hold a toy or dumbbell.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Encourage the dog to take the object in its mouth. Reward for holding it briefly, then for releasing it on cue.

column.name: name
column.value: Retrieve to Hand

column.name: description
column.value: Fetch an object and deliver it directly to hand.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Toss the object a short distance. Reward the dog for bringing it all the way back and releasing it into your hand.

column.name: name
column.value: Retrieve Over Obstacle

column.name: description
column.value: Retrieve an object while clearing a low obstacle.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Place a low obstacle between the dog and the object. Reward clean retrieves that clear the obstacle both ways.

column.name: name
column.value: Single Jump

column.name: description
column.value: Clear a single jump on cue.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Set the jump at a low height. Send or lead the dog over it, rewarding immediately on landing.

column.name: name
column.value: Jump Sequence

column.name: description
column.value: Clear a short sequence of jumps.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Arrange two to three jumps in a line. Handle the dog through the sequence, rewarding at the end.

column.name: name
column.value: Jump With Distraction

column.name: description
column.value: Clear a jump with distractions nearby.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Add a mild distraction near the jump. Reward the dog for staying focused on the obstacle and handler.

column.name: name
column.value: Straight Tunnel

column.name: description
column.value: Run through a straight, short tunnel.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Hold the tunnel open and call the dog through from the other end. Reward immediately on exit.

column.name: name
column.value: Curved Tunnel

column.name: description
column.value: Run through a curved tunnel.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Gradually increase the curve of the tunnel over sessions, rewarding confident, fast runs.

column.name: name
column.value: Tunnel Discrimination

column.name: description
column.value: Choose the correct obstacle when a tunnel is next to another piece of equipment.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Position the tunnel next to another obstacle. Handle the dog to clearly indicate the tunnel, rewarding correct choices.

column.name: name
column.value: A-Frame Basics

column.name: description
column.value: Climb and descend a low A-frame.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Start with the A-frame at its lowest height. Guide the dog over slowly, rewarding for touching the contact zone at the bottom.

column.name: name
column.value: Dog Walk

column.name: description
column.value: Cross a raised plank confidently.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Begin with the plank close to the ground. Reward a steady pace and a controlled stop in the contact zone.

column.name: name
column.value: Teeter Introduction

column.name: description
column.value: Get comfortable with the teeter's movement.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Start with the teeter propped near the ground so it barely moves. Gradually increase the tip as the dog gains confidence.

column.name: name
column.value: Short Straight Track

column.name: description
column.value: Follow a short, straight track.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Lay a short straight track with food drops. Let it age a few minutes, then work the dog along it on a tracking line.

column.name: name
column.value: Track With Turns

column.name: description
column.value: Follow a track that includes turns.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Lay a track with one or two turns. Allow the dog to work out the turn direction, rewarding at the corner.

column.name: name
column.value: Aged Track

column.name: description
column.value: Follow a track that has aged for an extended period.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Lay the track and let it age 30-60 minutes before running it, rewarding a confident, committed nose-down search.

column.name: name
column.value: Single Article Find

column.name: description
column.value: Locate and indicate a single article on the track.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Place one article partway along the track. Reward any clear indication (down, sit, or pointing) at the article.

column.name: name
column.value: Multiple Article Discrimination

column.name: description
column.value: Find several articles while ignoring distractor objects.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Place multiple articles and distractor objects along the track. Reward indications only on the correct articles.

column.name: name
column.value: Single Room Search

column.name: description
column.value: Search one room for a hidden target.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Hide a target in an easy spot in a single room. Send the dog in and reward a clear indication.

column.name: name
column.value: Multi-Room Search

column.name: description
column.value: Search multiple connected rooms.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Hide the target in one of several rooms. Let the dog work through each room systematically before rewarding the find.

column.name: name
column.value: Search With Distractions

column.name: description
column.value: Search an area containing distracting items or scents.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Add distractor scents or items near the target. Reward only indications on the correct target.

column.name: name
column.value: Exterior Vehicle Search

column.name: description
column.value: Search the outside of a vehicle.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Hide the target on the exterior of a vehicle. Guide the dog around the vehicle systematically, rewarding the indication.

column.name: name
column.value: Interior Vehicle Search

column.name: description
column.value: Search inside a vehicle with doors open.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Hide the target inside the vehicle. Allow the dog to search the interior with supervision, rewarding a clear indication.

column.name: name
column.value: Single Container Odor ID

column.name: description
column.value: Identify the container containing target odor.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Place several containers in a line with the odor in one. Reward the dog for indicating the correct container.

column.name: name
column.value: Multiple Container Search

column.name: description
column.value: Search a larger array of containers for the odor.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Increase the number of containers and vary their arrangement. Reward committed indications on the correct one.

column.name: name
column.value: Elevated Container Search

column.name: description
column.value: Search containers placed at different heights.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Place some containers on low platforms or shelves. Reward the dog for searching all levels and indicating correctly.

column.name: name
column.value: Vehicle Exterior Odor

column.name: description
column.value: Find target odor placed on a vehicle exterior.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Hide the odor source on a vehicle exterior. Guide the dog around the vehicle, rewarding a clear indication at the source.

column.name: name
column.value: Open Area Search

column.name: description
column.value: Search a larger outdoor area for the odor.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Hide the odor source in an open outdoor area with wind and natural distractions. Reward a confident, committed indication.

column.name: name
column.value: Parallel Walking

column.name: description
column.value: Walk calmly alongside another dog at a distance.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Walk both dogs in parallel with plenty of distance between them. Reward calm behavior and gradually reduce the distance.

column.name: name
column.value: Controlled Greetings

column.name: description
column.value: Greet another dog calmly on leash.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Allow a brief, calm greeting between two known dogs. Interrupt and reward if either dog becomes overexcited.

column.name: name
column.value: Play Break Recall

column.name: description
column.value: Recall away from play with another dog.

column.name: instructions
column.value: During a play session, cue a recall. Reward heavily for disengaging from play to come to the handler.

column.name: name
column.value: Meeting Strangers

column.name: description
column.value: Calmly meet an unfamiliar person.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Have a stranger approach slowly and offer a hand to sniff. Reward calm, relaxed body language.

column.name: name
column.value: Handling Desensitization

column.name: description
column.value: Tolerate handling of paws, ears, and mouth.

column.name: instructions
column.value: Gently handle one body part at a time, pairing each touch with a reward. Increase duration gradually.

column.name: name
column.value: Calm Around Children

column.name: description
column.value: Remain calm and gentle around children.

column.name: instructions
column.value: With supervision, allow calm, structured interaction with children. Reward gentle, relaxed behavior throughout.
